notes.title: 3.2.1 release
notes.notes:
Version 3.2.0 has been released.


 You can now choose a color when selecting a character.
 Voxel skin for the Hero can now be selected.
 Fixed text display issues in some languages.
 Added French language support.

notes.title: 3.2.0 release
notes.notes:
Version 3.2.0 has been released. As it is not compatible with previous versions, please install the latest version from the store.


 Slightly adjusted the probability for a player who repeatedly drew Clerk in the same room to draw Spy next.
 Fixed an issue where Red Riding Hood and Candy Apple Wand would not activate under the Curse of All Potions.
 Fixed an issue where the wrong player could be displayed as the winner when Mugen Recall activated.
 Fixed an issue where the Curse of Fog had no effect on CPUs.
 Fixed an issue in Story Mode where the source of ingredients obtained through video watching was not displayed correctly.
 Added Italian language support.
 Added Brazilian Portuguese language support.
 Added Russian language support.

notes.title: 3.1.0 release
notes.notes:
Version 3.1.0 has been released. As it is not compatible with previous versions, please install the latest version from the store.


Added an option to choose whether to display spectators' names and comments as they are.
Adjusted the reverse quiz so that questions about GOODS are less likely to appear.
Fixed the issue where most of the CPU's otherworldly ingredients were chocolate mint; now they vary depending on the character.
Resolved an issue where ordinary ingredients could sometimes be acquired as otherworldly ingredients due to the Stalker's effect.
Fixed the issue where the CPU would not recognize shrimp tempura added by others as otherworldly ingredients.

notes.title: 3.0.2 release
notes.notes:
Version 3.0.2 has been released. As it is not compatible with previous versions, please install the latest version from the store.


Fixed an issue where the Rock Glass was activating with ingredients other than the Mysterious Fin
Fixed an issue where the can badge obtained from the bonus drink added to the last pot was not reflected in the Infinite Collection condition
Fixed an issue where the effects of the Noble and Stalker were not resolving when the Ninja's form was visible
Fixed an issue where the CPU could find the Mysterious Fin in the ruins
Fixed an issue where the disadvantages of the Sake Cup and Masu were doubled when possessing the Hundred Medicines Curse
Fixed an issue where it was possible to obtain otherworldly ingredients with the effect of the Glowing Breadcrumbs

notes.title: Update on September 10, 2024
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Dark Fragments adjusted: -6 to -4
 Curse of Mist now reduces 2 ingredients (was 1)
 Added notifications for discarded ingredients
 Emphasized multiple same ingredient drops in ruins
 Fixed Bat Barrette calculation order
 Fixed text display issues in some languages
 Fixed rapid language change reflection issue


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on June 4, 2024
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Emphasized that all ingredients can be obtained in the ruins.
 Added the ability to check the cards included in each archetype from the room options settings screen.
 Disabled the speech bubble for decision-making when choosing a destination or vote without a declaration.
 Fixed an issue where the detailed display would get embedded at the bottom of the screen if the cursor was moved quickly in the inventory screen.


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on March 6, 2024
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 When you acquire ingredients or charms, we have made it so that you will be notified.
 Fixed an issue where the attributes of otherworldly ingredients were not being reflected despite being changed.
 Modified so that if a communication error occurs at the start of the game, you should exit once and attempt to rejoin.
 Fixed a problem where entering a room as a spectator after the person who created the room has left would result in an error.
 Fixed an issue where other players' otherworldly ingredients were being displayed in the history and inventory screens when set not to always show them.
 Fixed an issue where the spy's initial charm was not being displayed in the list of charms during CPU battles.


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on January 25, 2024
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 We have reduced the probability of the same person becoming the spy consecutively while playing in the same room.
 Adjustments have been made to increase the likelihood of questions about charms appearing in the turnaround quiz.
 Some of the questions in the high-difficulty turnaround quiz have been changed.
 The quiz asking about ingredients put into the pot in specified rounds has been discontinued.
 When acquiring ingredients through the secretary's effect, adjustments have been made to acquire ingredients that increase the amount of information as much as possible.


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on December 22, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Ensured that the order is unique when players line up in a circle.
 Added player names display during the game.
 Display the voted player when adding ingredients.
 Spies will now receive a notification of banned ingredients at the start of a round.
 Implemented notifications for curses during intermediate quizzes.
 Added curses to the list of cards displayed during the game.
 Added warnings for advanced settings.
 Fixed an issue causing freezing in Ghost matches.


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on December 08, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Adjusted the timing of the intermediate spy quiz
 Adjusted the probability of finding R amulets (R curses) before and after the intermediate spy quiz
 Adjusted the probability of which reward you get when you answer correctly in the intermediate spy quiz
 Changed the text of the rusty shovel
 Quiz questions no longer target CPU clerks if the CPU is a spy
 CPU spies no longer select only certain players for curses
 CPU clerks are now less likely to curse informants the day after a dark pot and are more suspicious of other players who have been cursed
 CPU clerks now place a higher value on having the same player as the other players when deciding who to vote for
 CPU clerks now place a higher value on the most recently visited location when deciding where to vote
 CPU clerks are less likely to collect amulets that are meaningless even if they have more than one


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on November 30, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Added a menu on the left side of the screen that lists the text of the cards used in that game
 When sharing information about ingredients that other players have put in the pot in the information store, it now shares the specific ingredients that were put in the pot, rather than "whether or not prohibited ingredients were put in".
 Fixed text for otherworldly ingredients
 adjusted victory points for ghost matches
 Added more options for victory points and time limit
 Fixed an issue where changing the time limit and then closing and reopening the options would cause the display to be incorrect
 Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes stop after re-entering a room if there was a communication error in the informant's office


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on November 24, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following


 Adjusted the difficulty level of some tutorials
 Improved an error that occurs when a player is kicked immediately after entering the lobby
 Correction of some texts


Thanks!

notes.title: Update on November 21, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following

・Fixed an issue that could cause rooms to freeze when multiple people enter at the same time.
・Added information on how to set the clock on the main unit to the correct time.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update: November 18, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The updates are as follows

・The game has been adjusted so that players will not be matched with the same ghost as many times in a row as possible.

・The text at the edge of the screen when four cards are lined up in a row has been adjusted to make it easier to see the text.

・Fixed a problem with the "Scattering" achievement for nobles not being released.

・The evaluation method of playstyle has been adjusted.

・When the time limit is set to 10 seconds in Ghost Match Chaos, the sharing of information in the information store has been changed to a simplified UI

・When a communication error occurs during multiplayer, it is now possible to leave the room and try to return to the game.

Thanks!
